marketplaceProductModel.api: GET /api/products exposes only active, non-archived public catalog fields.

commerceModels.cart: Customer-owned cart; item prices are resolved again when an order is created.
commerceModels.order: Stores a purchase-time snapshot of product names, unit prices, currency, quantities and totals.
commerceModels.payment: Stripe payment lifecycle model; no checkout or webhook handler is active.

implemented.fileLimit: 2 MB; at most 1000 records per import
implemented.websiteFetch: Not performed; URLs are stored after HTTPS validation to avoid arbitrary server-side fetches.
implemented.logoStorage: HTTPS URL only; binary upload/storage is not implemented.
implemented.productActivation: Requires active Company and ownerUserId assigned by administrator.
implemented.productListing: Active products are written to products; publication metadata marks marketplace, partner program and AI Qualitet.

outreach.consentRule: Imported leads default to marketingConsent=false; no bulk sending is enabled.

privacy: Actual firm, partner and contact records belong in MongoDB collections, not these checked-in memory snapshots.
